title: Jujutsu Kaisen
description: Test your knowledge of sorcerers and cursed spirits!

questions.question: What is the name of the main protagonist of Jujutsu Kaisen?
questions.explanation: Yuji Itadori is the main protagonist who swallows a finger of Ryomen Sukuna.

questions.question: How many fingers does Sukuna have in total?
questions.explanation: Sukuna has 20 fingers because the King of Curses had four arms.

questions.question: Satoru Gojo's signature technique is called Limitless.
questions.explanation: Gojo's inherited technique is Limitless, which manipulates space at an atomic level.

questions.question: What is the name of Megumi's domain expansion?
questions.explanation: Chimera Shadow Garden is Megumi's incomplete domain expansion using shadows.

questions.question: Who is the principal of Tokyo Jujutsu High?
questions.explanation: Masamichi Yaga is the principal of Tokyo Jujutsu High and a master of cursed corpse techniques.

questions.question: Nobara Kugisaki uses a hammer and nails as her weapons.
questions.explanation: Nobara channels cursed energy through nails she hammers into targets or straw effigies.

questions.question: What is the name of Yuji's special grade cursed weapon swallowed object?
questions.explanation: Yuji swallowed one of Sukuna's twenty fingers, becoming his vessel.

questions.question: Which curse user can manipulate souls through physical touch?
questions.explanation: Mahito's Idle Transfiguration lets him reshape souls and transform bodies by touch.

questions.question: What does Toji Fushiguro lack that makes him unique?
questions.explanation: Toji has zero cursed energy, granting him the Heavenly Restriction with peak physical abilities.

questions.question: Domain Expansions guarantee that the user's technique will hit their target.
questions.explanation: A sure-hit effect is the defining trait of a domain expansion against opponents inside it.

questions.question: What is the name of Gojo's Domain Expansion?
questions.explanation: Unlimited Void overwhelms victims with infinite information, locking them in place.

questions.question: What is Sukuna's Domain Expansion called?
questions.explanation: Malevolent Shrine is unique because it doesn't require a barrier, projecting open at massive range.

questions.question: Which technique does Yuta Okkotsu inherit from his deceased fiancée?
questions.explanation: Rika Orimoto became a special grade cursed spirit bound to Yuta after her death.

questions.question: Aoi Todo's cursed technique is called Boogie Woogie and lets him swap positions by clapping.
questions.explanation: Boogie Woogie swaps the positions of objects/people with matching cursed energy when Todo claps.

questions.question: What grade is the highest classification for jujutsu sorcerers?
questions.explanation: Special Grade is the highest tier, held by sorcerers like Gojo, Yuta, and Yuki Tsukumo.

questions.question: Who killed Satoru Gojo's mentor and led to him sealing himself in the Prison Realm?
questions.explanation: Kenjaku, inhabiting Geto's body, sealed Gojo in the Prison Realm during the Shibuya Incident.

questions.question: What is the name of Nanami Kento's cursed technique?
questions.explanation: Nanami divides his targets into segments, creating a forced weak point at the 7:3 ratio.

questions.question: Megumi Fushiguro is Toji Fushiguro's biological son.
questions.explanation: Megumi inherited the Zenin clan's Ten Shadows Technique through his father Toji.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT one of Megumi's shikigami?
questions.explanation: Tengu is not a Ten Shadows shikigami. Megumi controls Divine Dogs, Nue, Mahoraga, and others.

questions.question: What event takes place where many of Tokyo's residents are massacred by curses?
questions.explanation: The Shibuya Incident on October 31 marks the most devastating arc, with massive civilian and sorcerer casualties.

questions.question: Who is Yuji's grandfather, whose dying words influenced Yuji's worldview?
questions.explanation: Wasuke told Yuji to help others and die surrounded by people, shaping his moral compass.

questions.question: Reverse Cursed Technique allows sorcerers to heal themselves and others.
questions.explanation: RCT converts negative cursed energy into positive energy, enabling healing.

questions.question: What is Maki Zenin's defining trait among the Zenin clan?

options.text: Strongest cursed technique in the clan
Born with almost no cursed energy

questions.explanation: Maki has near-zero cursed energy, granting her enhanced physicality like Toji.

questions.question: What is the name of the special grade cursed object that Mechamaru piloted?
questions.explanation: Kokichi Muta controlled Ultimate Mechamaru remotely due to his Heavenly Restriction.

questions.question: Black Flash is a phenomenon that occurs when cursed energy is applied within 0.000001 seconds of a physical hit.
questions.explanation: Black Flash distorts space, dealing 2.5x the normal damage and amplifying cursed energy output.
